name: ZTZ-99A (Type 99A)
armament: 125 mm ZPT-98 smoothbore with carousel autoloader (gun-launched ATGM capable)
protection: Composite armour with wedge-shaped FY-5 ERA on turret front and side skirts, laser warning and soft-kill dazzler. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Low wide hull, length 11 m gun forward (hull ~7.6 m)
Arrow-head wedge turret front covered by flat ERA blocks; tall rectangular turret bustle box
Six road wheels per side, ERA-covered side skirts on the front half
Laser countermeasure/dazzler box on turret roof behind the commander; independent commander sight
Long 125 mm gun with thermal sleeve and fume extractor; QJC-88 HMG on a cupola mount
